theme_strategy.justification: Internal data-heavy operational dashboard. Light theme provides better legibility for dense tables, complex multi-step forms, and Looker Studio-style analytics. Users are travel admins processing orders in standard office lighting.

headings.usage: Use for all dashboard titles, page headers, KPI numbers, and card titles. Do NOT use Inter.

body.usage: Use for all tables, form inputs, labels, and standard body text. Excellent for tabular figures and currency (Rupiah).

palette.primary: bg-emerald-600 (#059669) - Main CTAs, active states, representing margin/profit/growth
palette.border: border-slate-200 (#E2E8F0) - Used for all grids, tables, and cards

rules: Do NOT use pure #000000 or #808080. Use Slate palette.
Hover states must be explicitly defined with higher contrast (e.g., hover:bg-emerald-700 hover:text-white).
No teal green (#1B93A4) for dashboards. Use Emerald or Indigo instead.
NEVER use fully transparent backgrounds for navbars, dropdowns, or modals. Always use solid white or a heavily blurred semi-solid surface.

layouts.app_structure: Left Sidebar Navigation (Dark Slate) + Top Header (White, Sticky, glassmorphism disabled, solid instead) + Main Content Area (Slate 50).

dashboard_grid.kpi_row: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 mb-6
dashboard_grid.chart_main: col-span-1 lg:col-span-8 (e.g., Line Chart for Trends)
dashboard_grid.chart_side: col-span-1 lg:col-span-4 (e.g., Donut Chart or Top Drivers)
dashboard_grid.table_row: col-span-1 lg:col-span-12 (Full width for detailed data tables)

components.cards: Flat design. bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl shadow-sm. NO heavy drop shadows. Title at top left, action (Export Excel) at top right.
components.tables: Shadcn UI tables. Very dense formatting. Text size text-sm. Right-align all numerical and currency columns. Left-align text. Use sticky header for long lists.
components.forms: Multi-step wizard for Input Transaksi Order. Horizontal progress indicator on top. Step 1: Info Dasar. Step 2: Biaya Operasional. Step 3: Multi-Driver Assignment. Use Shadcn inputs and date pickers. Never use native inputs.
components.buttons: Slightly rounded (rounded-md), crisp edges, hover transitions (transform & color). Use Lucide icons inside buttons.
components.charts: Shadcn Charts (Recharts). Looker Studio style requires clean grids, visible axes, and clear legends. Disable 3D styling. Emphasize tooltips with clear Rupiah formatting.
components.modals: Use Shadcn Dialog. Solid background. Overlay must be bg-black/40 (max 50% opacity).

motion.interactions: Subtle scale down on click (active:scale-95). Fast transitions (duration-150 ease-in-out) for colors.
motion.page_load: Staggered fade-in for dashboard widgets to simulate progressive data loading.
motion.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Ensure focus rings (ring-2 ring-emerald-500) are prominent.

specific_features.currency_formatting: Always format money as: Rp 1.000.000. Right-aligned in tables. Use Indonesian locale (id-ID) for all dates and numbers.
specific_features.multi_driver_input: Dynamic field array allowing 'Add Driver' within the order form. Must calculate 'total gaji driver' dynamically.
specific_features.export_excel: Every dashboard widget containing a table must have a prominent 'Export Excel' button (ghost or outline variant) in the top right corner of its card.
specific_features.filters: Global Date Range Picker and Search input at the top right of the Executive Summary dashboard. Local filters (Month/Year) inside specific cards (e.g., Driver Performance).

icons_and_assets.icon_library: lucide-react (Standard for SaaS). Phosphor Icons recommended for dashboard density if installed.

login_background.description: Mount Bromo Java Landscape - Aerial Photography of Volcano. Used for Login page background image with a dark overlay (bg-black/50) so Google Login card stands out.

testing.attributes: ALL interactive elements, form inputs, navigation links, and KPI displays MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='input-driver-name', data-testid='kpi-total-omset').

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You are building for a React + Tailwind + Shadcn UI stack using JavaScript (.js/.jsx), NOT TypeScript (.tsx). Convert component patterns to JS.
Do NOT use HTML-based components for advanced user interactions. Use Shadcn UI (Dropdowns, Calendar, Select).
Do not center align the app container in CSS. Keep standard document flow.
Ensure layering creates depth with z-index hierarchy but prefer solid or blurred backgrounds over transparent.
Include hover states and micro-animations for all buttons and interactive rows.
NEVER use generic placeholder text or dummy image URLs. If an image is needed and not provided, use an SVG pattern or CSS gradient.
Dashboard Looker Studio clone rules: Maximize data visibility. Use white cards on a light gray background. Do not add heavy drop shadows; use 1px borders. Use clear visual hierarchy for KPIs.
